Hi all,

Thanks Vivek — quick summary from Billing Ops:

What we need from NovaLabs to onboard a single-payor flow:
- Final PO (PDF) with the PO number and legal entity name exactly as your AP system expects (we can accept the draft but need the final PO before invoicing).
- Billing contact email for invoice delivery (invoices@novalabs-payments.com is fine).
- Remit-to / payor entity details (legal name + EIN) so we can set up the billing account.
- Completed W-9 or tax docs for your payor entity if the payor is US-based.

Net45 request: our standard Net30 is negotiable for renewals > $100k ARR. For Net45 we need:
- Deal lead sign-off (Vivek) + finance approval (Redwood CFO team). I can route the approval; turnaround is typically 3–5 business days once paperwork is in.

Process notes: once we have the final PO + W-9 and your billing contact, Billing will:
1) Create the consolidated payor billing account in our system.
2) Add the PO number to the renewal invoice and any subsequent monthly invoices until amended.
3) Apply Net45 to the renewal invoice upon approval; ongoing invoices will show the updated terms on the invoice PDF.

I've attached our invoice template for fields we need (Redwood_invoice_template.xlsx).

Let me know if you want a short call to walk the AP team through the fields.

Jordan Blake
